notes: The count and the committed hashes check out, and a committed M2 MATCH attestation exists. Two gaps stop this from being CONFIRMED. (1) The claimed replay result_sha256 comes from an R-13 run whose output was never committed, so the repository cannot show that the replay produced it. (2) The M2 attestation covers the source-log content hash 95a12c29, not cd9547c2 or the count itself. Read literally, 'an M2 attestation of it' overstates what M2 attested. Git commands were denied in this session, so the claim that this commit is on main rests on the task framing and the gitStatus snapshot.
